Samira K: Quick — Stellar Holdings wants co-listing + SI playbook for SSO (SAML), SCIM scoping, and BYOK via HSM. Need owners and a tiny test plan by EOW. @Ethan L @Marta V

Ethan L: I'll own marketplace copy + partner comms. Proposed checklist: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM attribute mapping (role -> entitlement), PKCS#11 import flow + rollback, legal/logo signoff.

Marta V: Security note: require HSM attestation (FIPS or SOC2), module manifest for PKCS#11, and audit event schema. SCIM must support server-side group filter param to avoid full directory pulls.

Ethan L: SCIM example we use in staging:
```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "stellar-test@redwood.ai",
  "groups": [{"value": "stellar-sales"}]
}
```
Also require support for `filter=groups.value sw \"stellar-\"`.

Marta V: BYOK outline: 1) exchange PKCS#11 module & slot info, 2) establish mutual TLS channel, 3) import wrapped key blob, 4) run sample encrypt/decrypt, 5) rotate and verify consumers. Rollback = switch to Redwood-managed keys + rotate consumers. Must emit audit events for key-import, key-rotate, admin-grant.

infra-bot: Draft playbook created at https://docs.internal/partners/stellar/onboard-playbook (editors: Samira,Ethan,Marta). Preflight CI: scim-smoke queued.

Samira K: Timeline: draft by Thu EOD, internal review Fri, partner review Mon, announce in 2 weeks. Sync tomorrow 9:00am PT — 30m. Agenda: confirm owners, add acceptance tests, legal assets. :calendar:

Ethan L: Acceptance test: provision user via SCIM with group stellar-ops -> entitlement shows in app -> call protected endpoint using entitlement. Block GA on failures.

Marta V: I'll add audit log examples and a short threat-model section to the playbook.

Samira K: Thanks everyone — will send the invite and confirm embargo contacts. :lock:
